reviews.title: Cheap deals does not automatically include quality service
reviews.body: Their cheap deals are because you will receive appalling unreliable service.  They have been throttling my data since I've been with them and they intensified it when my contract auto renewed after 8 months so that now I am forced to go whole evenings without internet access to way past midnight; webpages take excessively long to load or not at all and I am frequently put in offline status even though I have 100GB a month.  I cannot access important emails or send emails and cannot load internet pages or apps.  Family members informed me their calls are frequently not put through and told my phone is no longer available.  I am unable to tether.  There is definitely a pattern of instability that suggests it's intentional especially since I recently requested my PAC code.  I received a disconcerting call from Lebara shortly after asking me why I requested my PAC as if I'm not allowed to leave their disgusting service.  There is no quality of service and there is always a huge disparity between my phone's data usage information and Lebara's app info that invariably shows that I've consumed practically all my 100GB in approx 2 weeks and even when I have not tethered it claims I've used data tethering.  I have screenshot evidence to back up my claims.

reviews.title: Vulnerable disabled woman in crisis
reviews.body:
Imagine this.. 

A disabled, vulnerable woman has had her bag stolen. Amongst many sentimental things is her mobile and Lebara sim. 

Unfortunately she was unable to request a replacement sim through her online account as the email address has since changed. She had previously requested for the email to be amended on the account. Evidently this hadn’t been done. 

4 live chats, 3 voice calls chasing and 60 hours have now passed. The promised call back has not been attempted. 

A disabled, vulnerable woman is still without her number. Does not know when the replacement sim will be sent. The same SIM card that is required to schedule medication deliveries, confirm weekly hospital appoints and discuss results. 

You should be ashamed.

reviews.title: My whole family have Lebara SIM cards…
reviews.body:
My whole family have Lebara SIM cards but we are going to change after this experience.
Tried to cancel mum's contract when she lost her phone due to dementia in 2024. They wouldn't speak to me and she didn't understand how to speak to them.
They asked for her death certificate when she passed away a year later, which I sent but they are still taking payments. They have even included someone else's complaint within an email to me. They are now asking me to telephone  customer service again, which seems pointless as we just go round in circles. I get numerous emails from them saying. 'we have not heard from you within five days so are going to close your query' I keep telling them that this is because they haven't sorted it out.
They really can't be bothered.
